overview.title: The green lung of the Middle Atlas
overview.p1: Ifrane National Park protects forest and mountain habitats around the town. Visitors come for walks, clean air and a chance to see the Atlas environment that makes Ifrane different from Morocco’s imperial cities. Stay on marked routes and respect conservation rules.
overview.p2: Combine park edges with cedar stands and lakes for a full nature day based in Ifrane.
